metadata.title: An optimal pinching theorem on compact minimal submanifolds in the Euclidean spheres via eigenvalues of fundamental matrices
metadata.abstract: Based on an inequality on the upper bound of the sum of squared norms of Lie bracket of symmetric matrices, we establish a rigidity theorem for compact minimal submanifolds in the Euclidean spheres via eigenvalues of fundamental matrices, which are the critical values of the squared norms of the second fundamental form on all normal directions. This conclusion is optimal for all dimensions without the restriction of the codimension, giving a new characterization for generalized Clifford tori and Veronese manifolds.

analysis.progressType: 球面极小子流形的最优挤压
analysis.workSummary: 利用第二基本形式基础矩阵的特征值建立紧极小子流形刚性定理，刻画广义 Clifford 环面与 Veronese 流形。
techniques: 对称矩阵交换子不等式
analysis.breakthrough: 声称对所有维数及任意余维最优的挤压结论。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出精确挤压阈值及等号条件，须从主定理确定，不能补写未给出的常数。
analysis.priorityReason: 声称对所有维数及任意余维最优的挤压结论。
